info.title: FixIt API Backend
info.description: Equipment Maintenance Request System — all business logic endpoints

get.summary: Retrieve current SLA and shift-hours configuration (Supervisor only)

put.summary: Replace SLA and shift-hours configuration (Supervisor only); takes effect within 5 minutes

get.summary: List machines — active only by default; Supervisor may include inactive

post.summary: Add a new machine to the register (Supervisor only)

get.summary: List maintenance requests — Operator sees own; Technician sees all OPEN; Supervisor sees all

post.summary: Submit a new maintenance request (Operator only)

get.summary: Supervisor dashboard: status counts and overdue requests (>24 h open)
Server-Sent Events stream for real-time updates (all authenticated roles)

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of event types to subscribe to; omit for all

get.summary: Export aggregated downtime summary per machine per period (Supervisor only)
Export request records with all status transition timestamps (Supervisor only)
Aggregated downtime hours per machine for a given month (Supervisor only)

patch.summary: Transition a request: ASSIGN_TO_ME, START_WORK, or RESOLVE

400.description: Validation error or invalid state transition

403.description: Forbidden — wrong role or not the assignee

409.description: Conflict — request already assigned or in terminal state

get.summary: List resolved requests for a machine in reverse chronological order (all roles)
List comments for a request (all roles)

post.summary: Add a comment to a request (all roles)

patch.summary: Deactivate a machine (Supervisor only); requires explicit confirmation when open requests exist

400.description: forceDeactivate not set when open requests exist

next_cursor.description: Opaque; null on the last page
